changelog:
Interview Architect 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a comprehensive hiring interview system covering job scorecard creation, structured question banks, detailed evaluation rubrics, panel management, and offer recommendations.
- Enables interview planning for any role, targeted scorecard and question generation, technical assessments, candidate evaluations, and bias audits via simple prompts.
- Introduces clear scorecard templates distinguishing must-have vs nice-to-have competencies, measurable outcomes, and objective deal breakers.
- Provides structured interview loop templates with stage-by-stage guidance, role/level adjustments, and process timing best practices.
- Delivers curated behavioral and technical question banks with evaluation signals, plus take-home assignment guidance.
- Focuses on reducing subjectivity and bias, promoting evidence-based hiring decisions.
